title: Pay off debt or save? The order (Short)

lines.say: Pay off debt, or save first?
Starter emergency fund. Employer match. High-interest debt. Full emergency fund. Then bigger goals.

lines.cap: Why the match comes before the card: a 50% match adds 50¢ per dollar. Paying a 24% card saves 24¢.
lines.say: Why the match comes before the card: a fifty percent match adds fifty cents per dollar. Paying a twenty-four percent card saves twenty-four.
